GENERATE BURST K3-gen-walk-01 — Keeper walk-S loop, frames 0–3 of an 8-frame in-place walk cycle, on a 2×2 sheet (charter § 7 K3). task_id "K3-gen-walk-01".

Image 1 is the APPROVED IDENTITY MASTER (rest pose, direction S) — keep this exact character — a young woman; dark curly hair tied back; ivory shirt; navy sleeveless tabard, plain chest; one diagonal chestnut harness to an olive canvas satchel on her LEFT hip; one belt; laced bracers; navy trousers; chestnut boots; a plain walnut staff with brass ferrules in her RIGHT hand; no insignia anywhere. Deliver EXACTLY ONE 1254×1254 image: a 2×2 sheet of four consecutive WALK frames of that character walking IN PLACE toward the camera (direction S), row-major: frame 0 = CONTACT — right foot forward planted, left foot back; frame 1 = RECOIL — weight settling onto the right foot, body lowest; frame 2 = PASSING — left leg swings past the right, body rising; frame 3 = HIGH POINT — left foot about to plant, body highest. Arms swing naturally opposite the legs; the staff stays upright in the RIGHT hand and moves with that arm; the satchel sways slightly on the LEFT hip; the hair mass moves a little. Feet stay on the same baseline in every cell (in-place walk: the body does not travel across the cell). Every cell: IDENTICAL character size, head size, position on the cell's baseline, camera (elevated three-quarter, projection C), facing (S, toward the camera) and light (single key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT, fixed; no floor shadow). Exactly four square cells, row-major, no borders, labels or gutters; flat pure #00ff00 plate; do not mirror; do not zoom; do not matte.

One image_gen call; ONE retry only if a cell is off-plate, mirrored (staff in the wrong hand), or the sheet is not 2×2 — name the retry reason. Copy the final output from $CODEX_HOME/generated_images/... to out/k3_walk_S_00_03.png and compute its sha256. No code. No other files. No web. No agents.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "K3-gen-walk-01"): images = the one file with prompt, references (role + path), elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED; concerns naming anything you could not honour. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: APPROVED IDENTITY MASTER (rest pose, direction S): identity, costume, materials, register — every frame is this character
